title: Send your plans
text: Share your drawings, or photos and rough sizes if you don't have plans yet. We review them and come back with questions.

title: Site visit and estimate
text: We check the site, access and staging, then send a clear written estimate and a realistic schedule.

title: Schedule and frame
text: We book your start date, coordinate deliveries with you or your GC, and frame to the drawings.

title: Inspection-ready handover
text: We walk the frame, fix anything that's off and hand it over ready for inspection and the next trades.
